approvalSemantics: Every reference has an exact executable candidate source and full-image source-crop rule. No manual mapping or crop decision remains.

iphone-portrait.captureRule: Use an available current iPhone Pro-class Simulator in portrait and record exact model, OS, and pixels.

ipad-portrait.captureRule: Use an available 13-inch iPad Pro-class Simulator in portrait and record exact model, OS, and pixels.

macos-standard.captureRule: Capture the standard deterministic test window and record logical and pixel dimensions.

macos-resized.captureRule: Resize to the documented minimum supported window without clipping and record dimensions.

canonical-screen-v1.maskPolicy: Use only the declared package-supplied system-chrome mask.

workspace-empty.seed: Fresh deterministic workspace with no encoded result and the Theme selected.
assertions: Selected Theme applies to background, chrome, panels, and empty message surface.
All primary controls remain visible and usable.

compose-short.seed: Deterministic two-line canonical encoded sample using the Theme default Relic and Seal.
assertions: Two-line inscription stays inside the glyph safe region.
Relic ornament, Seal, and primary controls are not clipped.

compose-long.seed: Deterministic six-line canonical encoded sample using the Theme default Relic and Seal.
assertions: Long inscription fits without border, Seal, Frame, or Crest overlap.
Controls remain reachable at supported sizes.

inscription-preview.seed: Settled encoded result with the Theme default composition.
assertions: Interactive preview uses declared Relic, Script, Seal, optional Frame, and safe geometry.
No low-resolution or placeholder resource is visible.

received-cipher.seed: Valid incoming package with Theme presentation IDs and deterministic metadata.
assertions: Sender presentation remains visible.
Cipher, Relic, Seal, received state, and provenance metadata are readable.

share-builder.seed: Owned Theme with Share Builder open and default composition selected.
assertions: Preview matches the composition plan used for export.
Locked and owned choices are truthful and usable.

static-share.seed: Deterministic exported static share generated from the same composition plan as the interactive preview.
assertions: Output contains the same Relic, Script, Seal, Frame, safe areas, and crop as the interactive preview.
No UI chrome is baked into the output.

settings-codex-card.seed: Appearance Settings showing the target Codex card in its tested state.
assertions: Card uses Theme-owned art and truthful state text.
No provider icon or generic placeholder substitutes for the Codex card.

settings-defaults-preview.seed: Appearance Settings defaults preview using the Theme default Relic and Seal.
assertions: Defaults preview uses the shared composition renderer.
Selected defaults and visible composition agree.

vault-locked.seed: Target optional Codex not owned; Norse uses its Base-owned negative invariant.
assertions: Optional Codex locked state is visible, truthful, and disabled.
Norse must not expose this production state.

vault-progress.seed: Target optional Codex partially progressed toward unlock; Norse shows Base ownership rather than unlock progress.
assertions: Progress requirement and exact deterministic progress are visible.
State is not confused with ownership.

vault-encountered.seed: Codex or Artifact encountered through a valid incoming presentation but not owned.
assertions: Encountered state is visually distinct and text-labeled.
Encounter does not grant creation rights.
Owned state is visually distinct and selectable.
Ownership text and art agree.
Selected state is visible through shape and text, not color alone.
Selected card uses the Theme selected resource when declared.

relic-picker.seed: Relic picker open with all three Theme Relics and truthful ownership states.
assertions: All Relics use distinct approved silhouettes.
Thumbnails, names, descriptions, and lock states are readable.

seal-picker.seed: Seal picker open with all six Theme Seals and truthful ownership states.
assertions: All six approved Seals are present.
No system symbol or obsolete Seal substitutes for approved art.

mastery.seed: Theme mastery completed with Frame, Crest, and Title visible.
assertions: Frame, Crest, and Title are presented together.
Mastery art retains premium material detail and does not obscure content.

high-contrast.seed: Increase Contrast enabled with the Theme selected.
assertions: Script and state remain legible.
Theme identity and approved silhouettes remain recognizable without color-only cues.

reduce-motion.seed: Reduce Motion enabled with the Theme selected and preview settled.
assertions: Runtime motion diagnostics pass.
Preview exists, is visible, and is not clipped.
Static visual matches approved Theme authority.

large-text.seed: Accessibility large text enabled at the package-defined test size.
assertions: Text reflows without hiding required controls.
Theme art and Script safe regions remain usable.
